thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page triggered -> inference-gateway.eu-west1 high 5xx rate (alert id: PD-7321). Route: /v1/embeddings, 5m error rate = 13% > threshold 5%.
pagerduty: paging oncall-maya -> 2min delay, escalation in 5m if unacked.
oncall-maya: acked. I'm on it :eyes: What metrics do we have?
sre-ana: joining. Looking at grafana: error spike at 14:02 UTC, p95 latency up, origin upstream 502s from model-backend-eu-west1-b.
infra-mike: checking autoscaler + node pool. No autoscale failures in logs, but recent pod restarts on embeddings-worker-3.
oncall-maya: logs show flock of client retries -> 502s and some 504s. Sample log:
```
[14:03:11] proxy -> model-backend: 502 Bad Gateway, conn_reset
request_id=abcd-1234 path=/v1/embeddings model=embed-large seq=512
```
sre-ana: kv-cache eviction spikes correlate. kvcache eviction rate jumped ~14:01. Might be disk pressure on that host.
infra-mike: scaling embeddings-worker from 6 -> 10 replicas now, bumping node pool by +2. Manual scale in progress.
oncall-maya: diverting 25% of traffic to fallback model-embed-quantized (less capacity) as temporary safety.
product-julia: any customer-facing impact? Which customers?
oncall-maya: a few high-traffic tenants saw elevated error rates (~1.2% of global requests failed), pager shows increased error budgets for two customers. Not widespread but noticeable :frowning:. Updating status.
sre-ana: after scale start, error rate dropping to 4.8% at 14:06 UTC. Still watching for stability and kv-cache chatter.
infra-mike: new nodes are ready, pods scheduling. I'm draining the affected host (eu-west1-b-03) that showed disk IO saturation.
oncall-maya: thumbs up. Rolling back any recent infra change?
sre-ana: no recent deploys to embeddings service in last 30m. Root cause looks resource pressure (kvcache + retries) on a subset of model-backend machines.
product-julia: calling out to CS to inform impacted customers and to track SLAs.
oncall-maya: will keep 25% divert for 15m, then re-evaluate. If stable for 10m we'll remove divert.
incident-bot: Note: auto-escalation scheduled in 10m if error rate > 5%.
oncall-maya: can someone validate error logs for correlated client IPs? I want to ensure no upstream spike from customer side.
sre-ana: ran query, no single client dominating. It's a platform-side failure mode.
oncall-maya: OK. I'll start a short postmortem stub and handoff to oncall-liam at 14:30 UTC.
oncall-liam: (joining) taking handoff at 14:30 UTC, monitoring. If anything regresses ping me directly.
infra-mike: evicted pods from eu-west1-b-03, kvcache warmed on new nodes. No further restarts observed.
sre-ana: 14:12 UTC: error rate stabilized to 2.1% and trending down. p95 latency normalizing.
oncall-maya: removing 25% traffic divert at 14:16 UTC.
product-julia: noted — status page updated, CS notified of affected customers and mitigation steps.
oncall-maya: wrapping up. Will file postmortem and include mitigation checklist (autoscale tuning, kvcache thresholds, host IO alerts).
pagerduty: incident acknowledged and under engineering mitigation. Escalation timer cleared.
oncall-maya: handing off to oncall-liam for overnight watch. Thanks team :thumbsup:
oncall-liam: ack handoff. Will monitor next 6h and reopen if error rate > 3%.
